items.passageEn: Amy is excited. Tomorrow she will go to Japan for the first time. Her mother says, "Good luck! You are lucky to go on this trip." Amy is glad, but she is also a little sad. Her cat can't come with her.
items.passageZh: Amy 很興奮，她明天要第一次去日本。她媽媽說：「祝你一路順利！你能去這趟旅行真幸運。」Amy 很高興，但也有一點難過，因為她的貓不能跟她一起去。

questions.questionZh: Amy 為什麼有一點難過？
